heretic.why: Heretic optimises a per-component (per-matrix-type) subtraction weight with a float-interpolated direction index; weights may exceed 1 (over-subtraction).

mlabonne_gaussian.why: mlabonne v2 weights the subtraction by a Gaussian over layer depth (a spread and a peak layer), so per-layer strength is not uniform.

uniform_global_projection.why: W <- (I - r r^T) W applied at full unit weight in every residual-write matrix.
